Based on the search results, there are two key aspects to consider regarding the position of the 1st Governor-General of India:

## **Personnel Distinction:**
- **Warren Hastings** was the first Governor-General of Fort William/Bengal (1773-1785) under the Regulating Act 1773
- **Lord William Bentinck** was the first Governor-General of India *proper* (1833-1835), when the title officially became "Governor-General of India" after the Charter Act 1833

## **Position/Rank Details (for Lord William Bentinck):**
- **Military Rank:** Lieutenant-General (United Kingdom)
- **Honorable Designation:** The Right Honourable
- **Official Honors:** GCB, GCH, PC (Knight Grand Cross of the Order of the Bath, Royal Guelphic Order, Privy Council of United Kingdom)
- **Commands:** Commander-in-Chief, India; 11th Regiment of Light Dragoons

If you're asking about the **title/official position**, it was "Governor-General of India" with the honorific "The Right Honourable." If you're asking about the **military rank**, it was **Lieutenant-General**.
